question: The best practice that is involved in biological waste disposal is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**incineration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Incineration** is a widely accepted method for the disposal of biological waste, involving the burning of waste materials at high temperatures.
 
• This process reduces the volume of waste significantly, often by up to 90%, and destroys harmful pathogens, rendering the waste non-infectious.
 
• Modern incineration plants are equipped with pollution control devices to minimize the release of harmful emissions, making it an environmentally safer option compared to open dumping.
 
• Incineration of biological waste helps in the recovery of energy, which can be used for heating or generating electricity.
 
• This method is highly effective for the disposal of high-risk medical waste such as sharps, contaminated materials, and pathological waste.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autoclaving**:

 
 
• This method involves the use of steam under pressure to sterilize biological waste, effectively killing all pathogens.
 
• It is suitable for the treatment of a variety of medical waste, including cultures, stocks, and other infectious waste.
 
 
 
• **Microwave Treatment**:
 
 
• This technology uses microwave energy to disinfect medical waste, breaking down pathogens through heat and steam.
 
• Microwave treatment is effective and environmentally friendly, with minimal emissions.
 
 
 
• **Landfill Disposal**:
 
 
• Specially designed sanitary landfills are used for the disposal of treated biological waste.
 
• These landfills are equipped with liners and leachate collection systems to prevent soil and groundwater contamination.
 
 
 
• **Plasma Gasification**:
 
 
• This advanced technology uses plasma torches to convert waste into syngas, which can be used for energy production.
 
• Plasma gasification is an environmentally friendly option that reduces the volume of waste and eliminates harmful pathogens.
